method: Coordinated Terra subagents with primary-agent evidence review; static analysis and passive read-only runtime observation only.

safety.elevation: Owner-authorized hidden elevated PowerShell was used only to run supported read-only front-door commands after normal-integrity OpenProcess denial.

conclusions: The active Monza branch and placement-selector bands are asset-local and are not a universal numeric contract.
No universal wp_bitfields taxonomy is proven; shipped indexed values are only 0 and 1.
wp_event and wp_wpse target the same +0x134/+0x138 pair; the last applicable key encountered in file order wins.
The inherited 209-AIW lane-order result was not independently reproduced because its per-file manifest is not exposed by the current front door.

parser_hazards_found_by_independent_revi: The waypoint-count guard is reached only at wp_ptrs after current-record fields have already been written and the cursor can advance one record past the allocation; excess textual records are not proven safe.
Link remapping rejects -1 and indices greater than or equal to count, but other negative indices are not visibly rejected and can form pointers before the waypoint allocation.
Grid entries above authored rows but below startinggrid allocation are zero-filled in-bounds records; true unchecked-access risk starts at or above the allocation.

live_pit_event.result: Ordinary stride-aligned AI waypoint movement was captured, but no natural pit request or branch switch occurred; Monza event causality remains unobserved.

lifecycle_weather_identity.interpretation: Steady-play process churn was observed, but no weather rebuild or session/post/setup relocation can be attributed to this interval.
lifecycle_weather_identity.aiw_handle: The AIW handle is local to initialization: it is opened, passed to the parser, then closed before initialization returns. There is no persistent current handle to inspect during the running race.
allocation_facts: One waypoint allocation at AI database +0x134 stores 316-byte records; wp_path and wp_branchID are per-record metadata, not separate route arrays.
Reparse releases prior waypoint state and frees/reallocates grid, pit, and garage buffers.
Grid allocation uses startinggrid with minimum 104; pit allocation uses pitspots with minimum 52; garage allocation uses pitspots * garagespots with garagespots minimum 3.
No waypoint-count upper bound or multiplication-overflow guard was located.
lifecycle_weather_identity.weather: Static severity levels map to 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0, but no natural weather/grip transition occurred in the observed race.

review_corrections: The first live-pit report used topology from a different Monza asset and overlooked the approved custom runtime recipe. Its report now contains an explicit correction and uses the active 2002_Monza ranges.

The first cross-track summary overstated wp_wpse precedence, waypoint-count safety, negative-index safety, selector taxonomy, and grid OOB behavior. The primary agent corrected the additive summary before canonical integration.

extended_followup.natural_pit_result: A later 900-second monitor directly captured slot 18 routing from branch 0 at waypoint 115 to branch 1 at 945, remaining on branch 1 at 1009, then returning to branch 0 at 1103. CallToBox rose before pit entry and cleared while still on the pit branch.
extended_followup.event_node_limit: Records 983 and 984 are bracketed between captured branch-1 indices 945 and 1009, but were not directly sampled because the higher-frequency pointer stream had already reached its retention cap.
extended_followup.weather_session_result: A 600-second AIW monitor emitted zero rebuild events and a 900-second lap monitor recorded 199 ordinary monotonic +1 lap changes. Pre/post AIW header values were stable and the process diff produced no transition candidate; no weather or session transition occurred.
